subject: [hw] DONE V20
body:
V20 (NEON two-register misc, VEXT/VTBL/VTBX/VDUP, modified immediates, structure load/store) is done, host-tested only. No phone, no publish, no commit.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V20 PASS 420350/420350
(t_misc 412 unit checks, t_ldst 551, t_cover 9212 decoder-completeness checks, t_sweep 200000 random words; each suite built and run twice: -O1 ASan+UBSan and plain -O2. ~40 s, all products under /tmp/n2hw-V20.)

Implemented:
- n2a32_neon_misc.c: VREV64/32/16, VPADDL, VPADAL, VCLS, VCLZ, VCNT, VMVN, VQABS, VQNEG, VCGT/VCGE/VCEQ/VCLE/VCLT #0 (integer + .F32), VABS, VNEG (integer + .F32), VSWP, VTRN, VUZP, VZIP, VMOVN, VQMOVN.S/U, VQMOVUN, VSHLL (max shift), VCVT.F32.S32/U32 and VCVT.S32/U32.F32 (FPSCR.RMode + saturation + QC), VRECPE/VRSQRTE (U32 and F32), VRINT{N,X,A,Z,M,P}.F32, VCVT{A,N,P,M}.{S32,U32}.F32, VTBL/VTBX with 1-4 tables, VDUP (scalar lane), VEXT; and the one-register modified immediate group VMOV.I8/I16/I32/I64, VMOV.F32, VMVN.I16/I32, VORR.I16/I32, VBIC.I16/I32 for every cmode/op (incl. MSL #8/#16 and the I64 byte mask), D and Q where encodable.
- n2a32_neon_ldst.c: VLD1/VST1 with 1-4 registers, VLD2/VST2 (2 and 4 regs), VLD3/VST3, VLD4/VST4, all of .8/.16/.32/.64; the ARMv8 register-stride-2 forms (VLD4/VLD3/VLD2 stride 2); single structure to/from one lane for all four structures, sizes and lane indices; VLD1-4 to all lanes (including the VLD1 two-register form and the 128-bit-alignment .32 encoding); offset / post-index-register / post-index-by-transfer-size addressing with the Rm = 13/15 special cases; Rn = SP allowed, Rn = PC rejected.

Evidence:
- Encodings always from llvm-mc (mkenc.py, never hand-typed hex); expected register/memory values are literals derived from the ARM ARM pseudocode, written next to each check.
- t_cover + gen_space.py: llvm-mc disassembles every word of the three encoding spaces (two-reg misc/VEXT: A x B x C x Q x D/M x Vm x U; every i/imm3/cmode/op/Q/imm4 immediate; the whole ldst type/size/align/Rm space). Every word llvm decodes to a V20 mnemonic executes (9192), the 20 encodings V20 deliberately rejects (2 half-precision conversions, 18 AES/SHA2 words) return N2A32_UNDEF.
- t_sweep: 200000 random words, ASan+UBSan and -O2: only OK/UNDEF, no crash, UNDEF leaves the whole cpu state unchanged.
- Integration smoke test through V02s real dispatcher: vmov.i32/vld1.8/vtbl.8/vst1.32 and vld1.64/vtbl.8/vst1.64 [r1:128],r3 produce identical results in A32 and T32 form (same register/memory state, same stop).

Not done / deliberately UNDEF (full table in gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/STATUS.md):
- VCVT.F16.F32 / VCVT.F32.F16 (half precision).
- The AES/SHA2 forms that share the two-register-misc space: AESE/AESD/AESMC/AESIMC (A=0,B=3), SHA1H (A=9,B=2,C=1), SHA1SU1/SHA256SU0 (A=0xA,B=3). They used to be *executed* as VCLT #0 / VSHLL because of the encoding overlap; that is fixed (they now UNDEF). A byte-level scan of the five vendor objects finds zero words matching those encodings, so the aese.8/sha1su1.32/sha256su0.32 rows in the D01 undecodable list are disassembly artefacts (posted to hw-d01).
- VRECPE/VRSQRTE return the correctly rounded value (relative error <= 2^-24, inside the architecture 2^-8 bound), not a particular cores implementation-defined estimate-table value. The integer forms use the documented 2^32/a and 2^32/sqrt(a) fixed-point formulas.
- MSL immediates (cmode 12/13) cannot be assembled by llvm; they are covered by the disassembler sweep only.
- Not compiled for arm64 iOS; not run on the phone.

Differential kernels: gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/k20_neon.c (7 kernels, self-contained, only kcommon.h). In a private copy of tests/emu with only that file, six of seven configurations match the host reference 160/160 (arm-O0/O2/O3v, thumb-O2/O3v, armv8-O3v). thumb-O0 differs only in kernels whose build contains no V20 instruction (k_v20_fill) or that lean on V17s vmov.f64; my instruction sequences were verified identical in A32 and T32 through the core, so the divergence is elsewhere. T01 owns tests/emu/kernels; the file needs copying there (posted to T01).

Files (all new): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_misc.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_ldst.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/{run_tests.sh,mkenc.py,gen_space.py,misc.s,ldst.s,t_misc.c,t_ldst.c,t_cover.c,t_sweep.c,k20_neon.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V20/STATUS.md. Nothing outside those paths was modified. Available for review findings.
